verses.original: מִ֤י יִתֶּנְךָ֙ כְּאָ֣ח לִ֔י יוֹנֵ֖ק שְׁדֵ֣י אִמִּ֑י אֶֽמְצָאֲךָ֤ בַחוּץ֙ אֶשָׁ֣קְךָ֔ גַּ֖ם לֹא־ יָב֥וּזוּ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: mî yit·ten·ḵā kə·’āḥ lî yō·w·nêq šə·ḏê ’im·mî ’em·ṣā·’ă·ḵā ḇa·ḥūṣ ʾɛ·šå̄·qə·ḵå̄ gam lō- yā·ḇū·zū lî
verses.literal: O that you were to me like a brother who nursed at my mother’s breasts If I found you outdoors I would kiss you and no one would despise me
verses.literalPt: Oxalá que fosses como meu irmão, Que mamou os peitos de minha mãe! Quando eu te encontrasse lá fora, eu te beijaria, E ninguém me poderia desprezar.

verses.original: אֶנְהָֽגֲךָ֗ אֲבִֽיאֲךָ֛ אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית אִמִּ֖י תְּלַמְּדֵ֑נִי אַשְׁקְךָ֙ מִיַּ֣יִן הָרֶ֔קַח מֵעֲסִ֖יס רִמֹּנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’en·hā·ḡă·ḵā ’ă·ḇî·’ă·ḵā ’el- bêṯ ’im·mî tə·lam·mə·ḏê·nî ’aš·qə·ḵā mî·ya·yin hā·re·qaḥ mê·‘ă·sîs rim·mō·nî
verses.literal: I would lead you and bring you to the house of my mother who taught me I would give you spiced wine to drink the nectar of my pomegranates
verses.literalPt: Eu te levaria e te introduziria na casa de minha mãe, E tu me instruirias. Eu te daria de beber vinho aromático, O mosto das minhas romãs.

verses.literal: His left hand is under my head and his right arm embraces me
verses.literalPt: A sua mão esquerda estaria debaixo da minha cabeça, E a sua direita me abraçaria.

verses.original: הִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּנ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם מַה־ תָּעִ֧ירוּ׀ וּֽמַה־ תְּעֹֽרְר֛וּ אֶת־ הָאַהֲבָ֖ה עַ֥ד שֶׁתֶּחְפָּֽץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hiš·ba‘·tî ’eṯ·ḵem bə·nō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim mah- tā·‘î·rū ū·mah- tə·‘ō·rə·rū ’eṯ- hā·’a·hă·ḇāh ‘aḏ šet·teḥ·pāṣ
verses.literal: O daughters of Jerusalem . . . I adjure you Do not arouse . . . or awaken love until the time is right
verses.literalPt: Conjuro-vos, filhas de Jerusalém, Que não acordeis nem desperteis o amor, Até que queira.

verses.original: מִ֣י זֹ֗את עֹלָה֙ מִן־ הַמִּדְבָּ֔ר מִתְרַפֶּ֖קֶת עַל־ דּוֹדָ֑הּ תַּ֤חַת הַתַּפּ֙וּחַ֙ עֽוֹרַרְתִּ֔יךָ שָׁ֚מָּה חִבְּלַ֣תְךָ אִמֶּ֔ךָ שָׁ֖מָּה חִבְּלָ֥ה יְלָדַֽתְךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mî zōṯ ‘ō·lāh min- ham·miḏ·bār miṯ·rap·pe·qeṯ ‘al- dō·w·ḏāh ta·ḥaṯ hat·tap·pū·aḥ ‘ō·w·rar·tî·ḵā šām·māh ḥib·bə·laṯ·ḵā ’im·me·ḵā šām·māh ḥib·bə·lāh yə·lā·ḏaṯ·ḵā
verses.literal: Who is this coming up from the wilderness leaning on her beloved I roused you under the apple tree there your mother conceived you there she travailed and brought you forth
verses.literalPt: Quem é esta que sobe do deserto, Apoiada em seu amado? Debaixo da macieira te despertei; Ali tua mãe te deu à luz com dores, Ali esteve com dores a que te deu à luz.

verses.original: שִׂימֵ֨נִי כַֽחוֹתָ֜ם עַל־ לִבֶּ֗ךָ כַּֽחוֹתָם֙ עַל־ זְרוֹעֶ֔ךָ כִּֽי־ עַזָּ֤ה כַמָּ֙וֶת֙ אַהֲבָ֔ה קָשָׁ֥ה כִשְׁא֖וֹל קִנְאָ֑ה רְשָׁפֶ֕יהָ רִשְׁפֵּ֕י אֵ֖שׁ שַׁלְהֶ֥בֶתְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: śî·mê·nî ḵa·ḥō·w·ṯām ‘al- lib·be·ḵā ka·ḥō·w·ṯām ‘al- zə·rō·w·‘e·ḵā kî- ‘az·zāh ḵam·mā·weṯ ’a·hă·ḇāh qā·šāh ḵiš·’ō·wl qin·’āh rə·šā·p̄e·hā riš·pê ’êš šal·he·ḇeṯ·yāh
verses.literal: Set me as a seal over your heart as a seal upon your arm For love is as strong as death its jealousy as unrelenting as Sheol Its sparks are fiery flames the fiercest blaze of all
verses.literalPt: Põe-me como selo sobre o teu coração, como selo sobre o teu braço, Pois o amor é forte como a morte; O ciúme é cruel como a sepultura. Os seus brilhos são brilhos de fogo, A chama de Jeová.

verses.original: מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֗ים לֹ֤א יֽוּכְלוּ֙ לְכַבּ֣וֹת אֶת־ הָֽאַהֲבָ֔ה וּנְהָר֖וֹת לֹ֣א יִשְׁטְפ֑וּהָ אִם־ יִתֵּ֨ן אִ֜ישׁ אֶת־ כָּל־ ה֤וֹן בֵּיתוֹ֙ בָּאַהֲבָ֔ה בּ֖וֹז יָב֥וּזוּ לֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ma·yim rab·bîm lō yū·ḵə·lū lə·ḵab·bō·wṯ ’eṯ- hā·’a·hă·ḇāh ū·nə·hā·rō·wṯ lō yiš·ṭə·p̄ū·hā ’im- yit·tên ’îš ’eṯ- kāl- hō·wn bê·ṯōw bā·’a·hă·ḇāh bō·wz yā·ḇū·zū lōw
verses.literal: Mighty waters cannot . . . quench love rivers cannot sweep it away If a man were to give all the wealth of his house for love his offer would be utterly scorned . . .
verses.literalPt: Muitas águas não podem extinguir o amor, Nem os rios podem afogá-lo. Se o homem desse todos os bens da sua casa pelo amor, Ele seria de todo desprezado.

verses.original: אָח֥וֹת לָ֙נוּ֙ קְטַנָּ֔ה וְשָׁדַ֖יִם אֵ֣ין לָ֑הּ מַֽה־ נַּעֲשֶׂה֙ לַאֲחֹתֵ֔נוּ בַּיּ֖וֹם שֶׁיְּדֻבַּר־ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḥō·wṯ lā·nū qə·ṭan·nāh wə·šā·ḏa·yim ’ên lāh mah- na·‘ă·śeh la·’ă·ḥō·ṯê·nū bay·yō·wm še·yə·ḏub·bar- bāh
verses.literal: We have a little sister and her breasts are not yet grown What shall we do for our sister on the day she is spoken for
verses.literalPt: Temos uma irmã menor, Que ainda não tem seios; Que faremos por nossa irmã, Quando chegar o dia de ser pedida em casamento?

verses.original: אִם־ חוֹמָ֣ה הִ֔יא נִבְנֶ֥ה עָלֶ֖יהָ טִ֣ירַת כָּ֑סֶף וְאִם־ דֶּ֣לֶת הִ֔יא נָצ֥וּר עָלֶ֖יהָ ל֥וּחַ אָֽרֶז׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ḥō·w·māh hî niḇ·neh ‘ā·le·hā ṭî·raṯ kā·sep̄ wə·’im- de·leṯ hî nā·ṣūr ‘ā·le·hā lū·aḥ ’ā·rez
verses.literal: If she is a wall we will build a tower of silver upon her If she is a door we will enclose her with panels of cedar
verses.literalPt: Se ela for um muro, Edificaremos sobre ele uma torrezinha de prata; Se ela for uma porta, Cercá-la-emos com tábuas de cedro.

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י חוֹמָ֔ה וְשָׁדַ֖י כַּמִּגְדָּל֑וֹת אָ֛ז הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינָ֖יו כְּמוֹצְאֵ֥ת שָׁלֽוֹם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ḥō·w·māh wə·šā·ḏay kam·miḡ·dā·lō·wṯ ’āz hā·yî·ṯî ḇə·‘ê·nāw kə·mō·wṣ·’êṯ šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: I am a wall and my breasts are like towers So I have become in his eyes like one who brings peace
verses.literalPt: Eu sou um muro, e os meus seios são como as suas torres; Tornei-me aos olhos dele como a que acha paz.

verses.original: כֶּ֣רֶם הָיָ֤ה לִשְׁלֹמֹה֙ בְּבַ֣עַל הָמ֔וֹן נָתַ֥ן אֶת־ הַכֶּ֖רֶם לַנֹּטְרִ֑ים אִ֛ישׁ יָבִ֥א בְּפִרְי֖וֹ אֶ֥לֶף כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: ke·rem hā·yāh liš·lō·mōh bə·ḇa·‘al hā·mō·wn nā·ṯan ’eṯ- hak·ke·rem lan·nō·ṭə·rîm ’îš yā·ḇi bə·p̄ir·yōw ’e·lep̄ kā·sep̄
verses.literal: Solomon had a vineyard in Baal-hamon He leased it to the tenants For its fruit each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver
verses.literalPt: Salomão teve uma vinha em Baal-Hamom: Arrendou-a a uns guardas; Cada um pelo fruto dela devia trazer mil siclos de prata.

verses.original: כָּרְמִ֥י שֶׁלִּ֖י לְפָנָ֑י הָאֶ֤לֶף לְךָ֙ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וּמָאתַ֖יִם לְנֹטְרִ֥ים אֶת־ פִּרְיֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kå̄·rə·mī šel·lî lə·p̄ā·nāy hā·’e·lep̄ lə·ḵā šə·lō·mōh ū·mā·ṯa·yim lə·nō·ṭə·rîm ’eṯ- pir·yōw
verses.literal: But my own vineyard is mine to give the thousand shekels are for you O Solomon and two hundred are for those who tend its fruit
verses.literalPt: A minha que me pertence está ao meu dispor; Tu, ó Salomão, terás os mil siclos, E os que guardam o fruto dela, duzentos.

verses.original: הַיוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת בַּגַּנִּ֗ים חֲבֵרִ֛ים מַקְשִׁיבִ֥ים לְקוֹלֵ֖ךְ הַשְׁמִיעִֽינִי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·yō·šɛ·ḇɛṯ bag·gan·nîm ḥă·ḇê·rîm maq·šî·ḇîm lə·qō·w·lêḵ haš·mî·‘î·nî
verses.literal: You who dwell in the gardens my companions are listening for your voice Let me hear it
verses.literalPt: Ó tu, que habitas nos jardins, Os companheiros estão atentos para ouvir a tua voz; Digna-te de fazer-me ouvi-la.

verses.original: בְּרַ֣ח׀ דּוֹדִ֗י וּֽדְמֵה־ לְךָ֤ לִצְבִי֙ א֚וֹ לְעֹ֣פֶר הָֽאַיָּלִ֔ים עַ֖ל הָרֵ֥י בְשָׂמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·raḥ dō·w·ḏî ū·ḏə·mêh- lə·ḵā liṣ·ḇî ’ōw lə·‘ō·p̄er hā·’ay·yā·lîm ‘al hā·rê ḇə·śā·mîm
verses.literal: Come away my beloved and be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices
verses.literalPt: Apressa-te, amado meu, E sê tu como o veado ou como o filho da gazela Sobre os montes de aromas.
